name: harmony-email
description: Email Security MCP Server - investigate email security events, entities and restore requests via the HEC SmartAPI

options.description: Your HEC tenant entry-point hostname or portal URL
options.help: The hostname you use to reach the HEC portal, e.g. acme.avanan.net or https://acme.checkpointcloudsec.com/portal. The region, scope and API gateway are derived from it automatically.

options.description: API client id (Infinity Portal clientId, or the Avanan appId)
options.help: For Check Point tenants this is the Infinity Portal API key clientId (Global Settings > API Keys). For Avanan tenants it is the SmartAPI appId.

options.description: API secret (Infinity Portal accessKey, or the Avanan secretKey)
options.help: The secret half of the API key pair. Shown only once when the key is created. Treat it as a credential: never commit it, never paste it into a chat.

options.description: Force the auth flow: cloudinfra or avanan (default: derived from the domain)
options.help: Normally derived from your domain: *.checkpointcloudsec.com uses cloudinfra, *.avanan.net uses avanan. Override only when your credentials do not match the domain type.

options.description: API region override (default: derived from the domain)
options.help: For example us-east-1, eu-west-1 or ca-central-1. Set this together with scope and auth method to skip domain resolution entirely.

options.description: Tenant scope override, in the form farm:customer (default: derived from the domain)
options.help: For example mt-prod-cp-us-2:acme. Set this together with region and auth method to skip domain resolution entirely.
Raise this only if you routinely query very wide time windows.

options.description: Retries for rate limits and transient upstream errors (default: 3)
options.help: Applies to 408, 429 and 5xx responses and to connection failures. Read timeouts are never retried.
Backoff uses full jitter over this base, unless the server sends a Retry-After header.
Acts as a client-side rate limit while paginating large queries.

options.description: Maximum entities a single batch action may target (default: 50)
options.help: Safety cap on quarantine/restore/deny-restore batches. An oversized batch is rejected outright, never silently truncated.
